text: 'Clean financials from day one' is an intention, not a requirement -- this video pins it to one precise, testable definition.
Every transaction must post to the correct Company, Cost Center, and Account -- a correct company-level total is not enough.
The month-end close must finish on a defined calendar that Controller Simone Alvarez signs off on, not however long it takes.
Elena Marchetti must be able to pull a real department-level P&L by warehouse, not just one combined company number.
